name: Montalbano Jonico (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of green and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Montalbano Jonico (a black horse on a mount on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Montalbano Jonico, a comune in Basilicata; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Montalbano Jonico arms — black horse on a mount on blue, crowned, within branches
